description: Header file defining the Uploader class for crash report uploads in the breakpad project, including properties, initializers, and methods related to uploading minidumps and server communication.

classes.name: Uploader
classes.description: Objective-C class responsible for managing crash report uploads, including configuration, data handling, and network communication.

methods.name: initWithConfigFile
methods.description: Initializer that sets up the uploader with a configuration file.

methods.name: initWithConfig
methods.description: Initializer that sets up the uploader with a configuration dictionary.

methods.name: readConfigurationDataFromFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from a file and returns it as an NSDictionary.

methods.name: parameters
methods.description: Returns the mutable dictionary of parameters for the upload.

methods.name: uploadData
methods.description: Uploads specified data to the crash server with a given name.

methods.name: addServerParameter
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the server parameters dictionary.

methods.name: handleNetworkResponse
methods.description: Processes the network response and updates minidump filename accordingly.
